Fabrication schematic of temporal-responsive hydrogels (TRH) and their application in the bone-angiogenic cascade for diabetic bone regeneration by reprogramming energy-metabolic pathways

Fabrication schematic of temporal-responsive hydrogels (TRH) and their application in the bone-angiogenic cascade for diabetic bone regeneration by reprogramming energy-metabolic pathways. TRH contains Sr-HA, which promotes angiogenesis, and Ber-loaded microspheres that support mitochondrial regulation through the AMPK/PGC-1α-related pathway. Temporal drug release is designed to match the metabolic requirements of bone repair and to promote diabetic bone regeneration
